links.outcome: LLM accuracy on TCM exam questions by question type, model size, and prompt language
links.effect: Large-scale LLMs reached 69.01%-90.92% on single-choice but at most 8.40% on multiple-choice; evaluation was exam-style and not real-world clinical decision-making.
links.quote: While the current evaluation is based on examination-style tasks and does not involve real-world clinical decision-making, our findings provide insights to support the deployment of optimized models in resource-constrained healthcare environments.

unlisted_practices: Comparing lightweight versus large-scale LLMs for deployment in resource-constrained settings
Few-shot versus zero-shot prompting to improve accuracy
Prompt language (Chinese vs English) effect on LLM accuracy

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of various large-scale and lightweight LLMs on a traditional Chinese medicine examination dataset (comparing zero-shot vs few-shot prompting and English vs Chinese prompts), but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
